subject: Simple boolean condition
notes: kb/Work PB1412 + PB1464 LANDED (wave 1005 D). Rule: Boolean-expression-1 evaluates true if the result of the expression is 1 and false if 0 (cite.py --check 8.8.4.3.4 OK 1)). The three legal shapes the refuter named that never reached evaluation now do: the shift-only forms (IF BW B-SHIFT-L 1 false, B-SHIFT-LC true, (BW B-SHIFT-RC 1) true), the parenthesized bare operand (IF (BW), IF ((BW))), and - landed earlier by PB1465 - the parenthesized sub-expression after a binary operator or B-NOT. Values derived from 8.8.2 rules 8 and 9 in pb1412_shift_only_boolean_conditions and pb1464_parenthesized_boolean_operands.
